name: Star Ocean: The Second Story R dual screen
_about: Star Ocean: The Second Story R companion 1.0.1: the title screen, the party and each member's status, equipment, arts and skills, the Guide Map with the player's position and the game's icons, the missions and the battle, read live from the game's own objects and drawn with the game's font, words and pictures read from the player's own game files. Ships no game assets.
